Start with the user-specified folder.

Analyze file structure.

Map key directories (e.g., src/, config/, docs/).

Review required content:

Config files: Identify *.yaml, *.env, *.json, or *.toml in root/config folders.

Architecture: Extract from docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/design.md, or README.
Services: List APIs, libraries, or tools described in README or docs/services.md.

Purpose: 1 sentence.
Core components: [Service A, Service B, ...].
Key configs: [File + purpose].
Contribution rules: [Branching, testing, PR steps].
Rules:

Prioritize clarity over depth.
